__about: Grammar rules for one language. Copy this file to <code>.grammar.json (fr.grammar.json, es.grammar.json, pt-BR.grammar.json…). Lines starting with __ are explanations; leave them. The same file goes in every Axecleft module's lang folder.
__and: The word between the last two items of a list: "A, B and C".
__or: The same for "A, B or C".
__comma: What separates the other items of a list.
__articles: Articles, by gender and number of the word they go with: m (masculine), f (feminine), n (neuter), mp / fp / np (plural). {object:a} in a pattern uses "a"; {object:the} uses "the".
__defaultGender: The gender of a word the files don't know (m or f).
__elision: Words that lose their last letter before a vowel or a silent h (French: de épée → d'épée, le arc → l'arc). before: the letters that cause it; except: words starting with an aspirated h, which don't (de hache stays de hache). Leave words empty if the language has none.
__contractions: Pairs of words that merge (French de le → du; Spanish de el → del; Portuguese de o → do).
__capitalize: first: the name starts with a capital letter; none: as the words are written.
__words: What the grammar needs to know about some words, keyed by the word as it appears in this language (as Babele or the translation shows it): its gender (g: m or f), plural (pl: true), its forms when it agrees with another word (forms: { m, f, mp, fp }), the text to use instead (as: "de feu" for an ability Babele calls "Feu"), or the part of a name it moves to (role: "of" puts a weapon ability in the {of} part). The word files (next phase) fill most of this; you can add any word here.
